sentences.text:

For the Appellant : Mr. A. K. Sahani, Advocate For the State : Ms. Snehlika Bhagat, A.P.P ---------
06/Dated: 15.02.2024 I.A. No.5245 of 2023 Heard learned counsel for the appellant and learned A.P.P appearing on behalf of the State.
This interlocutory application has been preferred by the appellant for grant of bail to him during the pendency of this appeal.
Learned counsel for the appellant has submitted that the marriage between the appellant and the alleged victim was solemnized 05.06.2020.

Learned counsel for the appellant has further submitted that the age of the victim is assessed to be about 18 years after disclosing her age by the mother and grand-father of the victim and the Nikahnama was performed by Kazi.

Learned counsel for the appellant also submitted that earlier two cases of maintenance as well as restitution of conjugal rights have already been filed by the litigants and it indicates that the victim is a legally married wife of the appellant and therefore, the conviction of the appellant under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 6 of the POCSO Act is not justified and therefore, on this basis, he has been in custody after conviction.
Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for suspension of sentence and has submitted that the dispute between the parties has been arisen.

sentences.text: Having heard learned counsel for the appellant as well as learned counsel for the State and after going through the lower court records, we are inclined to release the appellant on bail.

Accordingly,
appellant, abovenamed, shall be released on bail, during the pendency of this appeal, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each,
to the satisfaction of learned Special Judge (POCSO), Godda in connection with Special (POCSO)
Case No.47 of 2021, subject to the condition that the appellant shall submit self-attested photocopy of his Aadhar Card and mobile number before the learned court below which he will always keep active and will not change it during the pendency of this case without prior permission of the learned court below.
The aforesaid I.A stands disposed of.

(Ratnaker Bhengra, J.) (Ambuj Nath, J.) BS-Saurabh /-
